groups.title: Loki Architecture
groups.question: Explain how Loki stores and indexes logs and how it scales.

followUps.Chunk Storage and Label Index: Why does indexing only labels make Loki cheap, and how does that shape which values you use as labels?
followUps.Loki Microservices and Scalability: Why does the Ingester need special care when you scale Loki, and what protects its data from loss?

groups.title: Promtail Collection
groups.question: Walk through how logs get collected and shaped before they reach Loki.

followUps.Scrape Configs and Pipeline Stages: Why is it useful to parse and label logs at ingestion time instead of at query time?
followUps.Kubernetes Log Collection Patterns: Why is dropping noisy logs at the collector better than filtering them later in Loki?

groups.title: LogQL Query Language
groups.question: Explain how you query logs in Loki and how you keep those queries fast.

followUps.Log Stream Selectors and Filters: Why does the stream selector matter more for query speed than the line filters that come after it?
followUps.Metric Queries from Log Data: When would you build a metric or alert straight from log data instead of using Prometheus?

groups.title: Cardinality and Cost Management
groups.question: Explain how you keep a Loki deployment healthy and affordable as log volume grows.

followUps.Label Cardinality Best Practices: What happens to Loki when someone uses a request ID or user ID as a label?
followUps.Log Volume Analysis with Grafana: How would you find out which teams produce the most logs, and why is reducing logs at the source the better fix?
